test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 08 Sept, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

I had / a bad habit of / waking up / lately.
solution:
The correct answer is 'lately' i.e. this part of the sentence has an error.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word '**lately**' is incorrectly placed in the sentence.
 
• It should be '**late**' to correctly describe the habit of waking up.
 
• The word '**lately**' is an adverb that means '**recently**' or '**in the recent past**'.
 
• In the context of the sentence, '**late**' should be used to indicate the time of waking up.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **late**.

Hence, the correct answer is option 1.

Correct sentence: *I had a bad habit of waking up **late***.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Adverbs like '**lately**' and '**late**' should be used correctly based on the context of the sentence.

 
 
• **Example:** *He has been arriving **late **to work every day.*
 
 
 
• Understanding the correct usage of adverbs can help in constructing grammatically correct sentences.
 
 
• Example: *She has been very busy **lately**.*
